title: Questions shown as a form are tried live against the Claude adapter
body:
coax-bdf289 adds form elicitation: the box for `AskUserQuestion` and for MCP servers that ask for input. Its tests drive the fake agent's `elicitation` step, which sends the forms a scenario spells out. Nobody has seen the box against the real Claude adapter.

## Proposal

Once coax-bdf289 lands, run coax against the Claude adapter in a decade pane and make Claude ask questions in each shape the adapter can send:

- one question with a single choice
- several questions in one request
- a question that allows several answers
- an option with a description, and one with a preview in `_meta`
- an answer typed into the `Other` field
- Esc, which sends `decline`, and Ctrl+c during the form

Record what reads badly or misbehaves as notes here, and fix it or file it.

## Open

- An MCP server that sends a form with number, integer or boolean fields, to try the field types `AskUserQuestion` never sends.
close_reason: Tried live in three rounds, with the results in the notes. A single question, several questions with a multiple choice, typed `Other` answers and Esc all worked. The awkward placement went to coax-93349c and the missing previews to coax-1f6264. Ctrl+c was left to the tests, since it would cancel the turn running the test.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bd10c4a0
notes.text: Live round 1, against the Claude adapter in coax. One question with a single choice worked, and so did three questions in one request with a multiple choice. Text typed into `Other` reached Claude as the answer for each question. Jack found the box floating over the middle of the transcript awkward to read against the chat behind it. Options with a code preview in `_meta` showed only their labels, because coax does not draw the preview, so a question that depends on its previews makes no sense.
